legend.en: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their post-human physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.

effect.en: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

legend.en: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.

when.en: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Have +6" R. Have +1 S.

legend.en: Hellfire rounds douse their targets in voracious acids that are utterly lethal to organic life.

when.en: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-non-VEHICLE 4+].

legend.en: Dragonfire rounds are designed to explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.

when.en: Your Shooting phase when a KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks: Can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Have [IGNORES COVER].

legend.en: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the tactical genius of the Deathwatch to best the myriad xenos foes they face.

effect.en: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

legend.en: Site-to-site battlefield teleportation is a rare capability indeed, used only by the Deathwatch in extreme situations.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves. If your unit has KILL TEAM, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.
